bio.text: Bob Smith is the Republican candidate for California's 24th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Salud Carbajal.
Smith served in the U.S. Navy from 1998 to 2024 and earned a bachelor's degree from Old Dominion University in 2006 and a graduate degree from the Naval Postgraduate School in 2015.

According to candidate-provided information on his Ballotpedia page, he enlisted as a technician on the AEGIS Weapon System, was commissioned as an officer in 2006, and served as a Surface Warfare Officer and later an Engineering Duty Officer.
